import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static final long inf = 2000000007L;
    static final int maxn = 1000004;
    static final int maxm = 204;
    static final int base_value = 1000000;

    static long n, answer;
    static List<Long>[] val = new ArrayList[7];
    static long[] sum = new long[7];
    static long count1, count2;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long down(long x) {
        return ((x % mod1) + mod1) % mod1;
    }

    static void build_tree(int depth, int number) {
        val[depth].add(down(count1 - number));
        count1++;
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            build_tree(depth + 1, number * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void traverse(int depth, long number, Scanner sc) {
        if (number > n) return;
        if (number * base_value + 999999 <= n && number * base_value * 10 > n) {
            for (int i = 0, multiplier = 1; i < 7; i++, multiplier *= 10) {
                long temp = down(count2 - number * multiplier + 1);
                List<Long> list = val[i];
                int position = lowerBound(list, mod1 - temp);
                long size = list.size();
                long sum_i = sum[i];
                answer = (answer + temp * size + sum_i - mod2 * (size - position)) % mod2;
            }
            count2 += count1;
        } else {
            count2++;
            answer = (answer + down(count2 - number)) % mod2;
            for (int i = (depth == 0 ? 0 : 0); i < 10; i++) {
                traverse(depth + 1, number * 10 + i, sc);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        build_tree(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
            for (long x : val[i]) {
                sum[i] += x;
            }
        }
        count2 = -1;
        answer = 0;
        traverse(0, 0, sc);
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
